mentions.name: Feather
mentions.description: Feather is a fresh implementation of TCL designed as an embeddable command language. It provides a Bash-like REPL for agents and users, giving embedders loops, conditionals, and online help for free so they only need to add application-specific commands. Feather has no garbage collector (uses the host's), no own data structures (uses the host's, e.g. JavaScript arrays in the js version), and no I/O; its core is implemented in stdlib-less C.
mentions.problem: Solves the "rest of the Owl" problem for embeddable scripting: embedders only need to add application-specific commands, while Feather provides loops, conditionals, and online help out of the box.
